notes.title: V1.1 Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!  It's been an AWESOME first day!  Thank you for you support. :)

V1.1 is a small patch - the game now defaults to full screen mode.  Windowed mode had some nice perks, but I do think full screen is a bit more professional.  You can switch back to windowed with the F11 key!

If you encounter any issues - please let me know and I'll get them fixed!

Josh
